methods.name: prepare_sig_file
methods.description: Prepares a signature file by reading, skipping header bytes, and copying the remaining data to a new file, then moves the temporary file to a specified location.

methods.name: prepare_app_manifest
methods.description: Generates various manifest files and paths required for the application, including moving, concatenating, and writing to files.

methods.name: prepare_rdm_files_for_sign_verification
methods.description: Performs multiple preparation tasks for signature verification, including managing cache and manifest directories, and decrypting the KMS public key.

methods.name: read_signature_file
methods.description: Decodes the signature file, reading and converting the signature from ASCII hex to binary.

methods.name: rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256
methods.description: Reads a file and computes its SHA-256 hash, useful for verifying file integrity.

methods.name: rdmInitSslLib
methods.description: Initializes the OpenSSL cryptographic library, setting up algorithms and error strings, and configures the library for subsequent cryptographic operations.

methods.name: manifest_file_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a manifest file by opening it and seeking to the end.

methods.name: rdm_openssl_file_hash_sha256_pkg_components
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-256 hash of a package component by reading the entire file and digesting it.

methods.name: openssl_verify_signature
methods.description: Performs cryptographic signature verification using OpenSSL EVP functions, validating the authenticity of a signature with a public key.

methods.name: rdmOpensslRsafileSignatureVerify
methods.description: Verifies the signature of a package file using a public key and a provided digital signature, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: rdmSignatureVerify
methods.description: Prepares files and invokes signature verification API for RDM files, including signature validation and OpenSSL context setup.
